title: Theory that the object was built before the ice age
summary: Dennis Asberg tells of Theory that the object was built before the ice age, about before the end of the last ice age (about 9600 BC) at Baltic Sea anomaly, between Sweden and Finland, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Long time ago, perhaps before the ice

plain: Dennis Asberg, a treasure hunter whose team found a strange shape on the floor of the Baltic Sea between Sweden and Finland, talks about where it might have come from. He suggests it was made a long time ago, perhaps before the last ice age. If true, it would mean someone built it far earlier than any known civilization.
